description: The Format 2 (table) VALUE clause (ISO §2023:13.18.63.2) - a literal list keyed to occurrence subscripts by a mandatory FROM (subscript) phrase with optional TO, initializing selected OCCURS-table elements/ranges. A COBOL-2002 addition. THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): the 1985 VALUE clause (§1985:VI.5.15.2) has two formats, `VALUE IS literal-1` and the condition-name list, and §1985:VI.5.15.5 GR2 confines the second: 'Format 2 can be used only in connection with condition-names'; §2002:13.16.61.1 prints 'Format 2 (table)' with `{ { literal-1 } … FROM ( { subscript-1 } … ) [ TO ( { subscript-2 } … ) ] } …`, §2002:13.16.61.3 GR12 gives its meaning ('A format 2 VALUE clause initializes a table element to the value of literal-1'), and §2002:F.2 item 71 states the change: 'Initialization of tables. The VALUE clause may be used to initialize selected elements of a table to specific values.' §2014:13.18.63.3 GR12 keeps it, so 2014 = 2023. Recognition-fired by VersionConformancePass.ParseArm.VisitValueClause on a valueClauseTablePhrase.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMVAL2.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 T-GRP.
   03 E PIC X(3) OCCURS 6 VALUES ARE "AAA" "BBB" FROM (1).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    DISPLAY E(1).
    STOP RUN.
